purpose: Teach: 招聘/来賓/一報/区役所/登用/譲り/心掛け/御礼

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、有識者、絶対、招聘、絶対、講演会、絶対、開催いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're absolutely committed to inviting expert speakers to hold lectures on these matters. Thank you for your understanding.
lines.style: Measured official tone. Even pacing, each clause given equal weight. Slight pause between the commitment and the gratitude. Composed but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、来賓、絶対、として、絶対、お招きいただきありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're very grateful to have the police represented here as honored guests and speakers.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive nod in his voice. Slightly formal register. Even tempo, acknowledging each point. Genuine warmth underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、事件、絶対、一報、絶対、入りました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: A report just came in regarding an incident. We appreciate you being informed immediately.
lines.style: Shift to procedural efficiency. Clipped delivery on the incident detail. Steady, professional. No drama — just factual handoff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と、本気で、絶対、区役所、絶対、連携、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're thankful for the coordination between the police department and the ward office on this.
lines.style: Affirming, collaborative tone. Slight emphasis on 'coordination' — showing he understands the weight of partnership. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、女性、絶対、登用、絶対、推進、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are actively promoting opportunities for female officers. We're committed to this direction.
lines.style: Deliberate, principle-forward delivery. Slight emphasis on 'actively' and 'promoting.' Calm conviction. No performative energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、譲り、絶対、合いの、絶対、運転、絶対、お願いされております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been asked to encourage safe driving practices—yielding, cooperative road behavior. We take that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly longer cadence. Listing the practices with gentle emphasis. Conversational but grounded. Ownership in his tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、安全、絶対、心掛け、絶対、徹底、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Safety awareness is something we're constantly reinforcing across all our operations.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate. Weight on 'constantly.' Measured pace. Professional assurance without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域からの、本気で、絶対、御礼、絶対、お言葉、絶対、警察、絶対、ありがたく頂戴しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The community's appreciation for the police department's work means a great deal to us.
lines.style: Warm conclusion. Slight softening from procedural tone. Genuine gratitude, not performative. Closing beat with quiet sincerity.
